title: Multimodal histopathologic models stratify hormone receptor-positive early breast cancer.
authors: Boehm, Kevin M; El Nahhas, Omar S M; Marra, Antonio; Waters, Michele; Jee, Justin; Braunstein, Lior; Schultz, Nikolaus; Selenica, Pier; Wen, Hannah Y; Weigelt, Britta; Paul, Evan D; Cekan, Pavol; Erber, Ramona; Loeffler, Chiara M L; Guerini-Rocco, Elena; Fusco, Nicola; Frascarelli, Chiara; Mane, Eltjona; Munzone, Elisabetta; Dellapasqua, Silvia; Zagami, Paola; Curigliano, Giuseppe; Razavi, Pedram; Reis-Filho, Jorge S; Pareja, Fresia; Chandarlapaty, Sarat; Shah, Sohrab P; Kather, Jakob Nikolas
one_liner_zh: 该文用多模态深度学习从H&E病理图像推断乳腺癌复发评分，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制完全无关。
abstract: The Oncotype DX(R) Recurrence Score (RS) is an assay for hormone receptor-positive early breast cancer with extensively validated predictive and prognostic value. However, its cost and lag time have limited global adoption, and previous attempts to estimate it using clinicopathologic variables have had limited success. To address this, we assembled 6172 cases across three institutions and developed Orpheus, a multimodal deep learning tool to infer the RS from H&E whole-slide images. Our model identifies TAILORx high-risk cases (RS > 25) with an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.89, compared to a leading clinicopathologic nomogram with 0.73. Furthermore, in patients with RS </= 25, Orpheus ascertains risk of metastatic recurrence more accurately than the RS itself (0.75 vs 0.49 mean time-dependent AUC). These findings have the potential to guide adjuvant therapy for high-risk cases and tailor surveillance for patients at elevated metastatic recurrence risk.
abstract_zh: Oncotype DX(R) 复发评分（RS）是一种针对激素受体阳性早期乳腺癌的检测方法，其预测和预后价值已得到广泛验证。然而，其成本和延迟时间限制了全球范围内的应用，此前利用临床病理变量估算RS的尝试成效有限。为解决这一问题，我们汇集了三个机构的6172例病例，开发了Orpheus，一种多模态深度学习工具，用于从H&E全切片图像中推断RS。我们的模型识别TAILORx高风险病例（RS > 25）的曲线下面积（AUC）为0.89，而领先的临床病理列线图为0.73。此外，在RS ≤ 25的患者中，Orpheus对转移性复发风险的评估比RS本身更准确（平均时间依赖性AUC为0.75对0.49）。这些发现有望指导高风险病例的辅助治疗，并为转移性复发风险较高的患者定制监测方案。
